title: Council critique
description: Output of a council member at the critique stage: a critique of every other member's proposal from the critic's own priority. Critiques address what the proposals say; they raise no new topics.

priority.description: The priority you critique from, as your seat names it.

critiques.description: One entry per proposal of another member.

agree.description: Points of the proposal you agree with, and why from your priority.

disagree.description: Points of the proposal you disagree with, and why from your priority.

challenged_assumptions.description: Assumptions of the proposal, stated or not, that you doubt.

assumption.description: The assumption, quoted or stated as the proposal relies on it.

challenge.description: Why it may not hold and what changes if it does not.

point.description: The part of the proposal you mean, briefly.

evidence.description: Sources for your reason, if it adds any to the proposal's.
